# Visit Lauderdale

> > Official tourism guide for Greater Fort Lauderdale, featuring beaches, dining, events, and travel itineraries across Fort Lauderdale, Hollywood, Deerfield Beach, and surrounding areas.

Visit Lauderdale is the destination marketing organization for Greater Fort Lauderdale, providing comprehensive visitor information including curated itineraries, dining guides, event calendars, and practical travel resources. The site covers attractions from Las Olas Boulevard to Fort Lauderdale Beach, Flagler Village, and the New River waterfront.

## Key Topics

- Greater Fort Lauderdale
- Las Olas Boulevard
- Fort Lauderdale Beach
- Downtown Fort Lauderdale
- Flagler Village
- New River
- Waterfront Dining
- Rooftop Bars
- 3-Day Itineraries
- Annual Events & Festivals
- Food & Wine Festivals
- Fort Lauderdale Air Show
- Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show
- Hollywood & Deerfield Beach
- FLL Airport

## Travel Planning & Itineraries

- [How to Navigate Fort Lauderdale - Hollywood International Airport Like a Pro](https://www.visitlauderdale.com/articles/post/guide-to-fll-airport): FLL Airport navigation guide with parking, TSA, and terminal amenities tips
- [3-Day Weekend Getaway | Greater Fort Lauderdale Itinerary](https://www.visitlauderdale.com/articles/post/3-day-weekend): Memorial Day weekend itinerary with beaches, dining at Flagler Village
- [3‑Day Luxury Escape | Greater Fort Lauderdale Getaway Guide](https://www.visitlauderdale.com/articles/post/luxury-escape): Luxury 3-day itinerary with Four Seasons, yacht cruises, and fine dining

## Dining & Nightlife

- [Restaurants on Las Olas Boulevard in Greater Fort Lauderdale](https://www.visitlauderdale.com/articles/post/where-to-dine-on-las-olas-boulevard): Las Olas dining guide with American Social and waterfront restaurants
- [Greater Fort Lauderdale Rooftop Bars, Restaurants, & Speakeasies](https://www.visitlauderdale.com/articles/post/rooftop-bars-and-speakeasies): Rooftop bars like Rooftop @1WLO and speakeasies including Sparrow
- [Best Greater Fort Lauderdale Bars | Must-Try Cocktails & Nightclubs](https://www.visitlauderdale.com/articles/post/greater-fort-lauderdale-bars-you-have-to-visit-at-least-once-in-your-lifetime): Must-visit bars guide including Kahuna Bar & Grill in Deerfield Beach

## Events & Festivals

- [2025 Must-Visit Events in Greater Fort Lauderdale](https://www.visitlauderdale.com/articles/post/2025-events-in-greater-fort-lauderdale): 2025 event calendar featuring food/wine festivals, music, and art in GFL
- [Fort Lauderdale Air Show | Schedule, Parking & Information](https://www.visitlauderdale.com/articles/post/fort-lauderdale-air-show): Air show guide with U.S. Air Force Thunderbirds at Fort Lauderdale Beach
- [An Ultimate Guide To The 2022 Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show](https://www.visitlauderdale.com/articles/post/an-ultimate-guide-to-the-2022-fort-lauderdale-international-boat-show): FLIBS 2022 guide covering the 63rd annual yacht show on Las Olas

## Outdoor Activities & Parks

- [Greater Fort Lauderdale Parks to Explore](https://www.visitlauderdale.com/articles/post/parks-to-explore): Parks guide featuring Hugh Taylor Birch State Park and Everglades trails
- [August Fishing Report in Greater Fort Lauderdale| Fishing, Marinas](https://www.visitlauderdale.com/articles/post/august-fishing-report): August wahoo fishing guide by Steve Waters covering full moon season
- [East Las Olas Boulevard Ranked Among Top U.S. Spots for a Healthy Stroll](https://www.visitlauderdale.com/articles/post/las-olas-boulevard-top-us-spots-for-a-stroll): East Las Olas Boulevard walking guide from beach to The LOOP district
- [A Park for Everyone: Inside the Reimagined Huizenga Park](https://www.visitlauderdale.com/articles/post/a-park-for-everyone-inside-the-reimagined-huizenga-park): Huizenga Park renovation with riverfront space near Las Olas Boulevard

## Seasonal & Holiday Guides

- [Best Places for Holiday Lights & Decorations in Greater Fort Lauderdale](https://www.visitlauderdale.com/articles/post/best-places-for-holiday-lights-decorations-in-greater-fort-lauderdale): Holiday lights guide featuring Las Olas Boulevard and Gulfstream Park
- [Festive Markets & Holiday Shopping Hotspots in Greater Fort Lauderdale](https://www.visitlauderdale.com/articles/post/holiday-markets-and-shopping-in-greater-fort-lauderdale): Holiday shopping guide featuring Flamingo Flea and Christmas on Las Olas
- [Exploring Greater Fort Lauderdale's Historic and Haunted Sites](https://www.visitlauderdale.com/articles/post/exploring-greater-fort-lauderdales-historic-and-haunted-sites): Historic Stranahan House Museum and haunted sites near New River

## Optional

- [15th Annual UKG & Salah Foundation Hero's Pride Move With MADD & MADD Dash Fort Lauderdale 5K](https://www.visitlauderdale.com/event/15th-annual-ukg-%26-salah-foundation-hero%e2%80%99s-pride-move-with-madd-%26-madd-dash-fort-lauderdale-5k/46726): MADD 5K charity race event at Huizenga Plaza raising impaired driving funds
